entities.name: MS-20 mini
entities.purpose: Reissue of the 1978 MS-20 semi-modular monophonic analog synthesizer with a patch panel, normalled internal routing and added MIDI/USB.
entities.synthesis_method: analog subtractive, two VCOs, HPF+LPF, patchable modulation

features.text: Described as a faithful analog recreation of the 1978 MS-20, with MIDI IN and USB added
Internal normalled routing plus a patch panel with mini-plug cables
Monophonic, highest-note priority

constraints.text: Original manual specs are 1978-era and may differ from the mini
Mini manual does not reprint the patch-panel voltage table

patching.summary: Normalled internal paths with a patch panel to override or extend them; mini-plug cables included

state_save.summary: No sound memory described; only auto power-off flag persists

external_control.summary: MIDI IN and USB MIDI notes on channel 1

entities.name: MS-20 (original)
entities.purpose: The 1978 original semi-modular monophonic synthesizer, documented by the reprinted original owner's manual.
entities.synthesis_method: analog subtractive, two VCOs, HPF+LPF, patchable modulation

features.text: Signal path VCO1/2, mixer, HPF, LPF, VCA with MG, EG1, EG2, noise and S/H modulation
Internal patches supplemented by a patch panel
ESP section for external instruments

constraints.text: Release date comes only from the mini manual

patching.summary: Internal patches with a patch panel; plugging a cable overrides the default source

state_save.summary: Setting charts only; no memory seen in pages read

entities.name: MS-20 patch panel voltage conventions
entities.purpose: Records the voltage ranges and trigger types printed for MS-20 patch jacks.

features.text: Keyboard CV exponential 0 to +8 V; VCO CV inputs linear 0 to +8 V
Filter, T.EXT and CV ranges in -5..+5 V; trigger jacks are ground-closure
Mini manual says internal voltage specs match the original

constraints.text: Out-of-range portions of a CV have no effect

entities.name: VCO 1 / VCO 2
entities.purpose: Two wide-range oscillators setting pitch and base timbre.

features.text: VCO1 32'-4', VCO2 16'-2'; waveforms triangle/saw/PW/noise and saw/square/pulse/ring
Selectable modulation sources by FM depth knobs and jacks

patching.summary: CV inputs replace keyboard pitch; FM jacks replace MG/EG1 sources

entities.name: VCHPF + VCLPF
entities.purpose: Series high-pass and low-pass voltage-controlled filters.

features.text: Each filter has cutoff, peak and two modulation depth knobs
Self-oscillation at maximum peak

constraints.text: Cutoff CV sensitivity printed as 20CT/V; meaning unconfirmed

patching.summary: Cutoff depth knobs use internal MG/EG2 unless a jack is patched

entities.name: Envelope Generator 2 (EG-2)
entities.purpose: Five-stage envelope driving the VCA and filter cutoff.

features.text: Hold, Attack, Decay, Sustain, Release
Normalled to VCA and filter modulation

timing.summary: Keyboard, momentary switch or external trigger starts the cycle

entities.name: Modulation Generator (MG)
entities.purpose: LFO with simultaneous triangle and rectangle outputs.

features.text: Triangle and rectangle at once; shape set by Waveform knob
Triangle normalled to VCO/VCF depth knobs

patching.summary: T.EXT input replaces MG source for all three depth controls

entities.name: External Signal Processor (ESP)
entities.purpose: Converts external audio into pitch CV, envelope and trigger for the MS-20.
entities.synthesis_method: preamp, band-pass, F-V converter, envelope follower

features.text: Pitch, envelope and trigger extraction
Mini manual defers to original for ESP

constraints.text: Requires level, threshold and CV adjust setup

patching.summary: Outputs are patched to VCO CV IN, trigger in and VCA initial gain

entities.name: Sample and Hold (S/H)
entities.purpose: Samples an input on each trigger and holds the value.

features.text: Used for random note and arpeggio effects

timing.summary: Clock from MG rectangle or any ground-closure source

entities.name: MS-20 mini sound recall (charts and patch book)
entities.purpose: Describes how sounds are recalled: by manual knob/cable setups from charts and a patch book.

features.text: 30-patch patch book and setting charts
Only auto power-off flag persists

constraints.text: No sound memory found in the documents read

state_save.summary: No patch memory documented; recall is by manual settings

entities.name: MS-20 mini MIDI IN / USB MIDI
entities.purpose: Note-only MIDI over DIN and USB.

features.text: Channel 1 fixed, notes only, velocity disabled on input
USB also transmits keyboard notes

external_control.summary: Notes via MIDI IN/USB; CV via KBD CV OUT

facts.statement: The mini manual calls the MS-20 mini a reincarnation of the original MS-20 (released 1978) that uses analog circuitry to recreate its sound; it points readers to the reprinted original Owner's Manual.
facts.locator: Owner's Manual (2015.06.01), section 'About the MS-20 mini' (EN)

facts.statement: Listed differences: compact size with mini-plug patch cables, added MIDI IN and USB port, VCA redesigned for better S/N, AC-adapter power. VCO and VCF are stated to be faithful reproductions; internal voltage specs are said to match the original.
facts.locator: Owner's Manual, 'About the MS-20 mini'

facts.statement: 37-key mini keyboard, control wheel and momentary switch; mono 1/8in SIGNAL IN/OUT (OUT 2 Vp-p, 3.5 kohm); stereo PHONES; DC9V jack, MIDI IN, USB type B; 493x257x208 mm, 4.8 kg; 10 patch cords and AC adapter included.
facts.locator: Owner's Manual, 'Specifications'

facts.statement: The mini manual warns that the original manual's wording and its specification figures date from 1978 and may differ from the mini.
facts.locator: Owner's Manual, 'About the MS-20 mini' note

facts.statement: Monophonic: with several keys held, only the highest note sounds.
facts.locator: Owner's Manual, 'Producing sounds'

facts.statement: Auto power-off is on by default and triggers after 4 hours without keyboard, MIDI/USB note-on or TRIG IN activity; the on/off setting is retained across power cycles and changed with a key-hold power-on combination.
facts.locator: Owner's Manual, 'Auto power off function'

facts.statement: The mini manual refers to the original manual for basic operation and ESP use, and shows a 'Normal Setting' diagram and patching examples.
facts.locator: Owner's Manual, 'Normal Setting', 'Patching to add variations to timbre'

facts.statement: The original manual presents the MS-20 as a Korg monophonic synthesizer built with the same technology as the PS-3100 and PS-3300 polyphonic models.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.1, 1) Introduction

facts.statement: 37 keys (C to C, 3 octaves); 10 W power consumption; 569x309x249 mm; 7.7 kg; patch cords and stand/case listed as accessory/option.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.8, 10) Specifications

facts.statement: Signal path: VCO1 and VCO2 into VCO mixer, then high-pass VCF, then low-pass VCF, then VCA, then volume. Modulation sources: MG, EG1, EG2, noise, S/H; plus an external signal processor section.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.2-3, block diagram and signal flowchart

facts.statement: The flowchart distinguishes audio paths from control-voltage paths; control signals reach VCO, VCF and VCA through internal patches that the patch panel can supplement.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.3, 3-2 Signal Flowchart

facts.statement: A 'Normal Setting' diagram gives a reference knob layout with all modulation off; the manual advises returning to it when starting a new sound.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.4, 4) Normal Setting

facts.statement: Patching guidance: decide the effect, then the control signal needed, then its source. A key press yields both a CV and a trigger. Patching a cable into an input breaks the internal connection of that input (e.g. second synth keyboard disabled when KBD CV/TRIG outputs feed it).
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.7, 6) About Patching and 7) Expanding Your System

facts.statement: Examples pair the MS-20 with the SQ-10 analog sequencer and the MS-10 using patch cords (KBD CV OUT and TRIG OUT to the other unit's CV and trigger inputs).
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.7, 7) Expanding Your System

facts.statement: The original manual includes a section of setting charts (section 11, from p.25) for recalling sounds by knob positions.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.i Index (11 Setting Charts)

facts.statement: The original owner's manual pages read carry no release date; the 1978 date comes only from the mini manual.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual (pages 1-8 read); see also SRC-004-02

facts.statement: Keyboard CV output is exponential, 0 to +8 V; KBD trigger output is a ground-closure type marked GND.
facts.locator: p.8 Specifications, Patch panel section 1 Keyboard

facts.statement: VCO 1+2 CV IN and VCO 2 CV IN take 0 to +8 V with linear response; a separate VCO 1+2 external frequency input is specified as octave-per-volt over -3 to +3 V.
facts.locator: p.8 Specifications, Patch panel section 2 VCO

facts.statement: External cutoff CV inputs for the high-pass and low-pass VCFs are -5 to +5 V, printed with a '20CT/V' sensitivity (unit meaning not explained in pages read); EXT SIGNAL IN is 3 Vpp max.
facts.locator: p.8 Specifications, Patch panel section 3 VCF

facts.statement: Total external modulation input (T.EXT) is -5 to +5 V; VCA initial gain input is 0 to +5 V; modulation VCA control input is 0 to +5 V with audio in/out -5 to +5 V.
facts.locator: p.8 Specifications, sections 4, 5, 10

facts.statement: EG1 normal output swings -5 V to 0 V and its reverse output +5 V to 0 V; EG1+EG2 and EG1 trigger inputs are ground-closure type.
facts.locator: p.8 Specifications, section 6 EG

facts.statement: MG triangle output is 5 Vpp and rectangle output is 0 to +5 V; noise outputs and S/H signal I/O are 5 Vpp; S/H clock input is ground-closure.
facts.locator: p.8 Specifications, sections 7-9

facts.statement: Control wheel output spans -5 V through 0 V to +5 V; momentary switch output is ground-closure; signal output is 2 Vpp.
facts.locator: p.8 Specifications, sections 11-12

facts.statement: A -5..+5 V signal patched into a 0..+5 V input only has effect in the 0..+5 V part; the manual tells users to check each jack's range and whether a signal is analog or trigger-type.
facts.locator: p.8 9) Caution (2)

facts.statement: The mini manual says its internal voltage specifications are identical to the original design, but does not reprint the panel voltage table.
facts.locator: Owner's Manual, 'About the MS-20 mini' (AC adapter bullet)

facts.statement: VCO1 scale spans 32' to 4' with triangle, sawtooth, pulse-width rectangle and white noise; VCO2 spans 16' to 2' with sawtooth, square, pulse and a ring-modulator mode.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.5, VCO (1)-(2) and p.8 Specifications

facts.statement: PW varies VCO1 rectangle width (0 = square); Pitch shifts VCO2 by +/- one octave; Portamento sets glide time; Master Tune adjusts both VCOs.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.5 (3)-(6)

facts.statement: Frequency modulation intensity knobs take the MG triangle (MG/T.EXT) or EG1 (EG1/EXT); a cable in the respective patch jack replaces the internal source with the external signal.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.5 (7)-(8)

facts.statement: VCO 1+2 CV IN and VCO 2 CV IN let an external controller replace keyboard pitch control; VCO 2 CV IN affects VCO2 only.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.6, Patch Panel (29)-(30)

facts.statement: Text says Master Tune covers about +/- 2 semitones while the spec list prints +/- 1/2 octave.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.5 (6) vs p.8 Specifications item 4

facts.statement: Separate voltage-controlled high-pass and low-pass filters in series, each with cutoff and peak (resonance); at maximum peak each filter self-oscillates.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.5, VCHPF and VCLPF (10)-(13)

facts.statement: Each filter's cutoff has two modulation depth knobs, MG/T.EXT and EG-2/EXT; with nothing patched they use MG triangle and EG2, otherwise the external jack source.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.5 (14)-(15)

facts.statement: External sound enters the filter and VCA path via EXT SIGNAL IN (3 Vpp max) and can be mixed with the VCOs using the VCO mixer.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.6 (35), p.5 VCO Mixer, p.8

facts.statement: EG2 has five stages: Hold, Attack, Decay, Sustain, Release; hold extends the trigger by a set time.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.6, Envelope Generator 2 (20)-(24)

facts.statement: EG2 is internally patched to the VCA and also modulates both filter cutoffs via the EG-2/EXT knobs.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.6

facts.statement: The envelope is triggered by the keyboard, the momentary switch or external TRIG IN jacks (EG1+2 TRIG IN); the trigger diagram shows 'on' as the low state.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.6 (31)-(32), EG-2 diagram

facts.statement: The MG outputs triangle and rectangle waves simultaneously; one Waveform knob varies their shape continuously and Frequency is shown by an LED.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.6, Modulation Generator (25)

facts.statement: The MG triangle feeds the VCO and VCF modulation depth knobs internally; patching into T.EXT replaces that source for all three.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.6 and p.7 (36)

facts.statement: The ESP contains a preamp, variable band-pass filter, envelope follower with trigger detector, and pitch-to-voltage converter, letting an external instrument drive MS-20 pitch, volume and envelope.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.7, (42) External Signal Processor

facts.statement: ESP outputs: amplifier out (0..+8 V), band-pass out, F-V CV out (0..+8 V), envelope out (0..+5 V), trigger out (ground-closure); front panel has signal level, low cut, high cut, CV adjust, threshold controls.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.8 Specifications, External Signal Processor

facts.statement: Use steps: connect source to SIGNAL IN, set level, set threshold, route F-V CV to VCO CV IN, TRIG OUT to trigger in, ENV OUT to VCA initial gain, then adjust band-pass and CV adjust to track pitch.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.7-8, 8) Using the ESP

facts.statement: The mini manual says the SIGNAL IN jack is for guitar or mic when using the ESP and refers to the original manual for ESP details.
facts.locator: Owner's Manual, Basic Operation 1. Connections item 4

facts.statement: S/H samples a patched-in signal each time it is triggered and holds the value until the next trigger; clock can be the MG rectangle or another source; used for random notes and arpeggio-like effects.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.7 (40)

facts.statement: S/H clock input is ground-closure; sample input and output are 5 Vpp.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.8 Specifications section 9

facts.statement: The original manual provides setting charts (knob-position diagrams) for sounds; no memory function appears in the pages read.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.i Index (11 Setting Charts); pp.1-8 read

facts.statement: The MS-20 Patch Book lists 30 patches across Bass, Drum, Keyboard, Lead and Sound Effect categories, flags which need a mod wheel or switch, and says they derive from the iMS-20 iOS app with a note that results will differ from hardware.
facts.locator: Patch book, contents list and 'Using this Patchbook'

facts.statement: The only user setting the mini manual says persists across power-off is the auto power-off on/off flag.
facts.locator: Owner's Manual, 'Auto power off function'

facts.statement: MIDI IN accepts only note messages on MIDI channel 1 (fixed) with velocity disabled; note number 92 or above stops the sound as invalid; 11 or below is ignored.
facts.locator: Owner's Manual, 4. About MIDI, MIDI IN connector

facts.statement: USB carries note messages on channel 1 in both directions; transmitted velocity is fixed at 64; pitch bend and modulation are not transmitted; KORG USB-MIDI driver is required.
facts.locator: Owner's Manual, 4. About MIDI, Connecting a computer

facts.statement: Implementation rev 1.0 (2012.10.25): transmitted notes 48-84 (37 keys), note on/off only; receives note on/off, All Sound Off, All Note Off and Omni/Mono/Poly mode messages.
facts.locator: MS-20 mini MIDI Implementation, sections 1 and 2-1

facts.statement: Keyboard CV/trigger can be sent to other gear via KBD CV OUT and KBD TRIG OUT; the manual says MIDI notes also count as activity for auto power-off.
facts.locator: Original Owner's Manual p.6 (33)-(34); mini manual 'Auto power off function'
